_comment: Source copy of ~/.copilot/hooks/hooks.json. Deploy via: python3 install.py
_native_preference: Commands prefer 'sk hooks run <event>' when sk is in PATH (native Rust binary or Python shim). Falls back to direct Python hook_runner.py invocation when sk is unavailable.

sessionStart.bash: if command -v sk >/dev/null 2>&1; then sk hooks run sessionStart; else python3 "$HOME/.copilot/tools/hooks/hook_runner.py" sessionStart; fi
sessionStart.powershell: if (Get-Command sk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { sk hooks run sessionStart } else { python "$env:USERPROFILE\.copilot\tools\hooks\hook_runner.py" sessionStart }
sessionStart.comment: [GLOBAL] Unified hook runner — auto-briefing + integrity check (prefers native sk)
